property_summary: After any number of successful fallback calls, C's pastBlockTime equals block.timestamp of the latest call, ensuring sequential calls require increasing timestamps. The mutant sets pastBlockTime before the check, causing the require to always fail under the same block.timestamp, thus leaving pastBlockTime unchanged and breaking the invariant that pastBlockTime must reflect the last successful call's block.timestamp.
change_summary: Move 'pastBlockTime = block.timestamp' before the second require statement
